llm.summary: This image-generation skill clearly discloses its account login, saved API key, and cloud uploads, with no harmful or hidden instructions found.

dimensions.detail: Prompts and explicitly supplied media are sent to disclosed dLazy endpoints. Local output downloads and bounded task polling fit the image-generation workflow.

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses a version-pinned npm installation and an npx alternative. The external CLI executable was not available for inspection.

dimensions.detail: Instructions cover image requests, authentication errors, and insufficient credits. They do not redirect unrelated tasks or authorize automatic purchases.

dimensions.detail: API-key storage in ~/.dlazy/config.json and the optional global CLI installation are disclosed. Environment-variable authentication is available; no unrelated credential access or persistent service is instructed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The banana2 commands support the declared image-generation purpose. The [publisher documentation](https://github.com/dlazy-ai/cli) also connects authentication with image generation.

llm.guidance: Use only prompts and images you are comfortable sending to dLazy, and consider its credit charges. Login saves an API key locally; use the documented environment-variable option if you prefer temporary authentication. Review the external CLI before installing.
